description: This Dart source file defines the HomeController class for a Flutter application. It manages the state and data for the home screen, handling content fetching, cache updates, and user interactions. It uses a repository pattern for data retrieval and employs state management techniques with ChangeNotifier.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: Controller class managing home screen data and state, including content loading, cache updates, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed content via the repository, manages loading state, and handles errors. Initiates loading of 'Continue Watching' items after initial success.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads recent watch history and content details for the 'Continue Watching' section, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the 'Continue Watching' list after playback progress is saved.

methods.name: setUserInteracting
methods.description: Sets the user interaction state, deferring cache refreshes during interaction and triggering refreshes afterward.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Forces a refresh of the home feed and continue watching list from cache.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and cancels timers when the controller is disposed.
